dossierText: Euclidean L2 Normalization projects vector embeddings onto unit hypersphere.

candidateRules.title: Metric Hypersphere Unit Projection (MHUP)
candidateRules.content: Normalize pooled embeddings with F.normalize(p=2, dim=1) to project onto unit hypersphere so dot product equals cosine distance.
candidateRules.summary: Euclidean L2 unit projection normalizing embeddings to unit hypersphere.
candidateRules.actionable_instruction: Apply F.normalize(p=2, dim=1) prior to vector database insertion.
